chunks: From him, from al-Naḍr and Faḍālah ibn Ayyūb, from Ibn Sinān, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
He was asked about a pregnant woman who sees blood: should she leave the salat (prayer)? He said: “Yes, indeed the pregnant woman may at times discharge blood.”
ai.seo_question: If a pregnant woman sees blood, should she stop performing salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the legal ruling concerning a pregnant woman who sees blood and whether she should suspend salat (prayer). Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام replies in the affirmative, indicating that pregnancy does not prevent the occurrence of blood discharge that carries legal consequence in this context.
